answer: Correlated-trigger forfeiture pool: every identity contributes a share of earnings to a pool that pays out only to audit survivors. When the saffron seed flags a cluster, each linked account loses its whole contribution, and a summit-scaled penalty doubles with each prior flag. A farm with k fakes funds k pool shares every epoch, and a single violet of synchronized behavior burns the whole pool it stood on. Honest agents reclaim accrued shares after clean audits; a sybil's own capital compounds against it, so the cost of k identities grows faster than k outputs.
